In addition to the great points made in links, this type of research is absolutely the gold-standard for selection bias. The only thing a study of this group of people can determine is what people of that exact social/demographic group tend to be like. It's entirely related to social dynamics of their particular status group and says absolutely fuck all about the rest of the population.

This is a known problem with scientific research in the 20th century (reliance on college students for testing) and it renders most sociological research completely valueless outside of the testing group. You can safely draw some population-wide conclusions about biophysical functioning from studying a group of private college students because our biophysical traits don't vary much - you absolutely cannot determine what people think, feel, or believe, using that same test group.
